name: codex-finish-shout
description: Monitor live Codex projects and individual agent tasks in open VS Code workspaces, confirm project-wide idle completion, announce it locally, and update an attached ESP32 status display.

interface.shortDescription: Project-wide Codex status monitoring with reliable final-completion announcements.
interface.longDescription: Combines the official user-level notify event with trusted lifecycle hooks so a turn boundary becomes a candidate rather than an immediate project completion. Every candidate waits for a project-wide quiet window; new prompts, resumed sessions, active subagents, or a newer completion cancel the stale candidate. Live VS Code workspace leases and SessionEnd cleanup remove closed projects, while a periodic full snapshot restores the ESP32 display after reconnect or resume. During settling the monitors stay red, and only the final idle state turns green and announces once.
capabilities: Per-agent task titles, independent execution states, and parent-child overview
Hardware-first completion display with desktop fallback
Live workspace presence and SessionEnd cleanup
One-click Codex Hook trust onboarding with readiness feedback
Automatic ESP32 USB Serial/JTAG port detection
Automatic single-root and multi-root workspace matching
Lossless serial playback queue for concurrent projects
Configurable one-shot, loop, and timed playback
defaultPrompt: Check my Codex completion reminder status.
Help me change the local completion MP3.
